name: morning-ai-brief-player
description: A weekday, editorially selective audio brief for an engineering leader moving a company toward an AI-driven SDLC. It collects public RSS items, asks Gemini whether the day has enough useful material, creates a conversational two-host episode when warranted, converts it to MP3, and publishes an RSS feed on GitHub Pages. Episodes aim for a commute-length listen when the news supports it; thin days are skipped and strong but limited news gets a shorter episode.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
